label: Two B-26s down south-east of here: map grid square T5026
source: 45th Inf Div G-2 Periodic Report No. 219 p. 2
note: The Army's maps were ruled in 1 km squares (the Nord de Guerre grid); a report could give the square, not a point, so the whole square is drawn, hatched.
